name: watchdog-died
goal: Breakage test of the launcher's death detection: every client's game is killed at the first awakening recap (crash-at); client1's crash is an expected one, client2's is not: the launcher reports DIED client2 and aborts the run within seconds (exit 125) instead of waiting for the host's timeout.

expect.cmd: python -X utf8 Packages/com.unpseudo.autoplay/Tools~/check_alerts.py {run} "DIED client2 exit=" "ABORT a process died"
